0.why: Moffenzeef 2.6.1 source (github.com/moffenzeefmodular/VCVrack-submission commit e6a0c67), src/BadIdea9.cpp:47-48: cvInput = inputs[PWR_INPUT].getVoltage() then clamp(cvInput, 0.0f, 5.0f); mono: the plugin reads every input with getVoltage() and the only setChannels in src is Kleztizer.cpp:305

comment: Read from the maker's source at 2.6.1, commit e6a0c67. The frequency law is f = 1885 - 353*x for the main oscillator and f = 3000 - 598*x for the sync oscillator, where x = clamp(starve + 5 - 10*knob, 0, 5), and each result is clamped to 120..1885Hz and 10..3000Hz. With the starve jack empty x is 5 - 10*knob, so the whole audible sweep happens in the first half of each knob's travel. The output is the filtered square multiplied by starve/5, which is why an unpatched module makes no sound.
